headline: Voted for Horace Mann Lab School over CLC for Book Swap Sept 19, with one abstention.
summary: Members reviewed past events, including the Swap'N'Drop, the Styrofoam drop-off, and the Living Green Expo, and discussed upcoming events. They approved the June 2026 minutes unanimously. They voted for Horace Mann Lab School over CLC for the Book Swap, with one member abstaining.
decisions: Approved the June 2026 minutes unanimously by all members in attendance.
Voted for Horace Mann Lab School over CLC as the Book Swap venue, with one member abstaining.

decision_evidence.quote: Minutes June 2026 meeting Approved unanimously by all members in attendance.
Vote for HMLS vs CLC with changes: All voted for HMLS with one member abstaining
